from collections import OrderedDict

liked = []
page_limit = 20
page_index = 0
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    liked.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

library = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    library.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

library_song_ids = {s['song_id'] for s in library}
intersection = [s for s in liked if s['song_id'] in library_song_ids]

titles = [s['title'] for s in intersection]

print('liked_count', len(liked))
print('library_count', len(library))
print('intersection_count', len(intersection))
print('sample_titles', titles[:20])
